task.description:
Reported by Matt Barge on review of cmsqffot3000004kyj9iw230o (2026-09-22): the Meet our Team carousel shows no previous/next arrows, so Jason Tan on slide 6 is reachable only by the small bullets.
Page: https://alpha.school/san-francisco/ (object 6544)

Element: nested-carousel widget f4f2bbf (#team_carousel)
Observed: stored setting arrows = "" (off); rendered wrapper lacks elementor-arrows-position-inside. Pre-existing: the 2026-09-22 add touched only the new slide and carousel_items (receipts 11930, 11931); the reframe touched only the image widget (11967, 11968).
Expected: arrows on, as on Miami and Santa Barbara (both render elementor-arrows-position-inside). Arrow size (20px) and colour are already configured on this widget.
Why the agent did not fix it: prepare_elementor_content_patch refuses the field (alpha_mcp_field_not_editable: arrows); the MCP has no widget display-setting allowlist yet (MCP issue filed for 0.5.8).
Recommended path: Elementor edit by website operations: open the San Francisco page, select the Meet our Team carousel widget, Content tab, Arrows: on, update. Five seconds. The website agent verifies the rendered arrows afterwards with a section capture.
Done when: the rendered carousel shows previous/next arrows on desktop and mobile and the wrapper carries elementor-arrows-position-inside.
